# nizima LIVE triggers

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to nizima LIVE.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%nizima.host%` | The computer nizima LIVE runs on |
| `%nizima.port%` | The port number it uses |

<small>Type id: `nizima.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when the connection to nizima LIVE drops, for example because you closed it.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%nizima.host%` | The computer nizima LIVE runs on |
| `%nizima.port%` | The port number it uses |
| `%reason%` | Why it dropped |

<small>Type id: `nizima.disconnected`</small>

## Selected model changed

Runs when you select another model in nizima LIVE (the one Cuebot's steps act on when they name no model).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Models** | Only react to these models. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%nizima.host%` | The computer nizima LIVE runs on |
| `%nizima.port%` | The port number it uses |
| `%model%` | The model now selected |
| `%modelId%` | nizima LIVE's number for that model |
| `%previousModel%` | The model selected before |

<small>Type id: `nizima.modelChanged`</small>
